scope: Legacy Overworld map data and spawn; finite border placement verified and retained

native_instruction_fixtures.method: Isolated execution of original PS4 instructions with controlled inputs; not captures of complete PS4 worlds

adaptations: Native 1.17.1 map IDs, saves, colors, and packets
World/player UUID zero-versus-nonzero map history instead of PS4 map-ID storage
Forge initial-world-spawn event and native bonus chest feature
Java initial-player construction hook with transient entity RNG
One-handed map viewport scaling below 16:9, separate from unchanged paper inset and coordinates
limitations: Full terrain, decoration, cave, and some structure behavior still uses existing target-runtime adapters
Exact final PS4 world spawn for every seed is not established
Exact player landing depends on transient entity RNG
Physical macOS Retina hardware and running PS4 visual comparisons were not tested
